$ archo env add shared --like main
env:shared  added
  game: $ROOT/Steam/steamapps/common/RimWorld
  version: 1.6.4633 rev1261
  saves: own
  user-data: $ROOT/ArchoHome/userdata/shared
  launch: steam
  sources:
next:
  archo scan

$ archo plan list
plans: 1 (env:main)
  plan:default  1 active  1 version  never played  [current]
next:
  archo plan new <name> --from current

  archo scan

$ archo env add selected --like main --list fresh
env:selected  added
  game: $ROOT/Steam/steamapps/common/RimWorld

  saves: own

$ archo env use selected

next:
  archo status

$ archo plan list

  plan:default  1 active  1 version  never played
  plan:fresh    1 active  1 version  never played  [current]
next:
  archo plan use <name>
